create_3d_box_corners: create 3D box corners from size, heading angle, and center position using rotation matrix
compute_2d_box_iou: compute pairwise IoU between two sets of 2D bounding boxes in xyxy format
compute_3d_box_iou: compute pairwise IoU between two sets of 3D bounding boxes in xyzxyz format
compute_generalized_box_iou_3d: compute generalized IoU for 3D bounding boxes accounting for non-overlapping cases
convert_box_coordinates: convert between center-width-height and corner-coordinate box representations
